author: reek
body: A declared linear parameter is unaliased within its function body by the ownership discipline. Stage 0 of NoAliasCodegen surfaces that fact at emit time as the CDX4011 info diagnostic on memory accesses whose base is the linear owner. This test pins the whole carrier chain: the LinearTy wrapper must survive the registered signature, deep-resolve, and lowering into IRDef unique-params, or the diagnostic never fires and the diag sidecar fails the battery.
